name_zh: 塞尔维亚正教会/精神领袖：正教协商制与圣萨瓦传统
name_en: Serbian Orthodox Church/Spiritual Leaders: Orthodox Consultative Governance & St. Sava Tradition
description_zh: 塞尔维亚正教会 (SOC) 1219 年圣萨瓦建立自治教会，1346 升格牧首区，历经奥斯曼米勒特制/南斯拉夫无神论/后共复兴，始终是塞族民族认同的精神内核。核心治理机制：主教圣统会议 (Holy Assembly of Bishops) 协商决策——牧首首席主教/主教团共识/修道院长老参议，教会法 (Kormchaya) 规范神职/婚姻/遗产/教育。体现 M160 正教协商制——以"圣统会议共识+修道院精神权威+教会法规范"三位一体，在政权更迭中提供民族精神连续性锚定。
description_en: Serbian Orthodox Church (SOC) autocephaly 1219 St. Sava, patriarchate 1346, survived Ottoman millet system/Yugoslav atheism/post-comm revival, remains spiritual core of Serb national identity. Core governance mechanism: Holy Assembly of Bishops consultative decision-making—Patriarch primus inter pares/bishops consensus/monastic elders advisory, canon law (Kormchaya) regulates clergy/marriage/inheritance/education. Exemplifies M160 Orthodox Consultative Governance—trinity of 'Holy Assembly consensus + monastic spiritual authority + canon law normativity' providing ethnic spiritual continuity anchor across regime changes.
reason_zh: 塞尔维亚正教会非单纯宗教机构，而是"民族精神存续操作系统"：奥斯曼期米勒特制保存民族性、南斯拉夫期地下坚持、后共复兴成道德权威。M160 区隔于 M149 伊斯兰咨询(舒拉)、M150 塔木德辩证(犹太)、M176 萨米协商(议会)，核心在于"圣统会议共识+修道院权威+教会法"的正教治理三位一体。
reason_en: Serbian Orthodox Church not mere religious body but 'ethnic spiritual continuity OS': Ottoman millet preserved nationhood, Yugoslav era underground persistence, post-comm revival as moral authority. M160 distinct from M149 Islamic Shura (consultation), M150 Talmudic Dialectic (Jewish), M176 Sami Consultation (parliament), core: 'Holy Assembly consensus + monastic authority + canon law' Orthodox governance trinity.
steps_zh: 圣萨瓦自治教会建制：1219 尼西亚获自治权，确立牧首/主教/修道院三级治理，圣萨瓦成民族精神始祖
奥斯曼米勒特制生存：牧首任民族领袖(米勒特巴什)，教会法管辖婚姻/继承/教育，保存语言/习俗/身份
南斯拉夫无神论抗争：铁托政权迫害神职/没收财产/控制教育，地下礼拜/地下神学院/修道院坚持精神抵抗
后共复兴与道德权威：1990s 恢复合法地位/夺回财产/介入政治调解/战争罪证言/欧盟入盟道德把关
圣统会议协商机制：牧首首席主教/主教团共识/修道院长老参议/教会法法庭，决策经祈祷/斋戒/共识
steps_en: St. Sava autocephaly establishment: 1219 Nicaea granted autocephaly, established Patriarch/bishops/monasteries three-tier governance, St. Sava as ethnic spiritual progenitor
Ottoman millet system survival: Patriarch as ethnic leader (millet-bashi), canon law jurisdiction over marriage/inheritance/education, preserving language/customs/identity
Yugoslav atheism resistance: Tito regime persecuted clergy/confiscated property/controlled education, underground worship/clandestine seminaries/monasteries maintained spiritual resistance
Post-comm revival & moral authority: 1990s restored legal status/reclaimed property/political mediation/war crimes testimony/EU accession moral gatekeeping
Holy Assembly consultative mechanism: Patriarch primus inter pares/bishops consensus/monastic elders advisory/canon law courts, decisions via prayer/fasting/consensus
expected_zh: 以"圣统会议共识+修道院精神权威+教会法规范"三位一体，在帝国兴衰/意识形态更迭/战争创伤中提供民族精神连续性锚定，为正教民族提供治理范式。
expected_en: Trinity of 'Holy Assembly consensus + monastic spiritual authority + canon law normativity' provides ethnic spiritual continuity anchor across empire rises/falls, ideological shifts, war traumas, providing governance paradigm for Orthodox nations.
case_zh: 1219 自治→1346 牧首区→1766 奥斯曼废除/1920 恢复→1941-44 纳粹占领迫害→1945-90 无神论打压→2000s 复兴/道德权威→2019 牧首波菲烈访俄/普京会晤，八百年精神连续性。
case_en: 1219 autocephaly -> 1346 patriarchate -> 1766 Ottoman abolition/1920 restoration -> 1941-44 Nazi persecution -> 1945-90 atheist suppression -> 2000s revival/moral authority -> 2019 Patriarch Porfirije visits Russia/meets Putin, eight-century spiritual continuity.
intellectual_tradition: Orthodox Canon Law / Hesychasm / St. Sava Legacy
cross_cultural_impact: Orthodox governance model; canon law for family/inheritance; monasticism as spiritual resistance; moral authority in politics
colonial_history: Ottoman millet system; Austro-Hungarian pressure; Nazi occupation
diaspora_influence: SOC eparchies worldwide (US/CA/AU/DE/AT/SCAND); diaspora spiritual center
indigenous_knowledge_system: Monastic oral tradition; hesychast prayer; iconography as theology
